tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condition as per tender documents

Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which have been engaged by the Purchaser to supply goods for the preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used for the supply of goods to be purchased under this Invitation for Tenders

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices (Black List) issued by any State Government or PSU or by Government of India or Local Bodies as on Bid Submission Date
In the event that two or more Bidders have been ranked L1 the purchaser may Will be allotted based on highest turnover with similar supplies in past three years

Bidders are permitted to submit proposals for either one or both packages (Package 1 and Package 2) through the e-procurement portal in response to this Tender document. If a bidder chooses to apply for both packages, they must submit separate proposals for each, ensuring that they meet the specific technical and financial eligibility criteria. Any participation in a package by a bidder must be done independently, multiple bids for the same package by a single bidder under different names or partnerships shall result in disqualification.
If the bid value is more than the tender amount, then the bidder will be rejected
The final quantity and amount shall be as specified in the purchase order or work order.
The Sample & Demonstration shall be conducted on 26.05.2026 between 11.00 am to 3.00 pm for participating bidders only.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have executed Supply of IT Hardware and Maintenance of similar projects worth not less than Rs.7200 lakhs for package 1 and Rs.88 lakhs for package 2, in any one year out of last 3 Years to any Government / PSUs. The bidder shall have executed supply of Interactive Display Board of Rs.2700 lakhs for package 1 and LED Projectors of Rs.33 lakhs for package 2 in single contract/order/bill. For MSME as per order FD908 Exp-12/2019 dated 21-07-2020 is applicable.
The bidder shall be a Company registered with concerned authority and should be operating in India for the past three years (2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-25, and 2025-26)

The bidder must be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized dealer certified by the OEM. Both Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and their authorized dealers are eligible to bid. Only one representation is allowed. More than one authorization will be disqualified. OEM should have at least three years of presence in India with commercial activities in technology solutions. OEM must have their own manufacturing/contract manufacturing facility in India from last three years for manufacturing Display/Projector.

For Package 1 - The Bidder shall have Service Centres in each of the districts being serviced (for the purpose of service centres, bidders own service centres in case of authorized dealer or OEMs service centres of similar products or MOU with any existing service centres in the districts are considered.) to provide requisite services to destinations as per Annexure-3. For Package 2 - The Bidder shall have Service Centres at district / division level being serviced (for the purpose of service centres, bidders own service centres in case of authorized dealer or OEMs service centres of similar products or MOU with any existing service centres in the districts are considered) to provide requisite services to destinations as per Annexure-3A
Land Border Preferences as per Government Order NO: FD455Exp-12/2020 Bengaluru, Dated: 01.04.2023
The bidder shall have positive net worth in each of the last 3 audited financial years ending March 2025.

The bidder shall have average annual turnover of Rs.18000 lakhs for package 1 and 230 lakhs for package 2 in the last 3 audited financial years for supply and service of goods of similar nature (2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-25). For MSME as per order FD908 Exp-12/2019 dated 21-07-2020 is applicable
